name: veyra-platform
description: Veyra Platform backend - central service for Veyra Desktop and Veyra Website

scripts.build: npm --workspace apps/api run build && npm --workspace packages/contracts run build && npm --workspace packages/sdk run build
scripts.test: npm --workspace apps/api run test && npm --workspace packages/contracts run test && npm --workspace packages/sdk run test
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace apps/api run typecheck && npm --workspace packages/contracts run typecheck && npm --workspace packages/sdk run typecheck
